title: Administrator Reception
description:
Admin Receptionist - Temporary

Location: Edinburgh
Pay: £13.00 per hour
Contract: 6-week temporary placement
Start Date: Immediate

We are currently recruiting for an Admin Receptionist to join a busy and friendly organisation based in Edinburgh. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator or receptionist who is immediately available and looking for a short-term temporary position.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing incoming telephone calls and responding to general enquiries
- Welcoming visitors and providing a professional reception service
- Carrying out general administrative duties and maintaining accurate records
- Managing emails, correspondence and internal communications
- Supporting colleagues with day-to-day administrative tasks
- Updating databases, filing documents and maintaining organised records

About You
- Previous administration or reception experience
- Confident and professional telephone manner
- Strong organisational skills with good attention to detail
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office and general IT systems
- Friendly, reliable and able to work effectively within a busy environment
- Immediately available

title: HR Assistant
description:
Edinburgh or Glasgow Hybrid Working Full-Time

I'm working with a respected professional services organisation looking to appoint an HR Assistant to join their established People team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who is looking to develop a career in HR, or for an experienced HR Administrator seeking a varied role with exposure across the full employee lifecycle.

Key responsibilities:
- Provide HR administration support across the employee lifecycle, ensuring records and documentation remain accurate.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR queries, delivering a professional and responsive service.
- Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activity for new employees.
- Maintain and update the HR system, producing reports and assisting with people data requirements.
- Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, policy updates and wider team initiatives.

What we're looking for:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR, recruitment or a people-focused environment.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and contribute to continuous improvement.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive team where you'll gain broad HR exposure, build new skills and play an important role within a well-established organisation.

To apply for this role, please send your CV or contact Anthony Oliva at Iconic Resourcing for a confidential chat and further details. At Iconic Resourcing, we understand that not all candidates will meet every single desired qualification or skill for the job positions posted on behalf of our clients.

However, if you believe you can add value to the role despite your experience looking a little different from what we've outlined, we would be thrilled to learn more about you.

title: IT Helpdesk Analyst (German Speaking)
description:
Job Title: IT Helpdesk Analyst (German Speaking)

Location: Edinburgh Sighthill North OR Leeds Wellington Place

Hourly Pay Rate: £18.25

Start Date: December 1, 2026

Contract: Temporary position, 6 months with potential for progression.

Working Hours: You'll work 35 hours per week across Monday to Friday, with shift rotations between 7:00am and 7:00pm.

Hybrid Working: 2 days per week working from the office, 3 days working from home.

Training Period: During the first 3 months, all training will be delivered from the office. Candidates must be able to attend the office full-time throughout this period before moving to the hybrid working pattern.

Join Lloyds Banking Group!

Lloyds Banking Group is looking for a fluent German and English speaker to join their IT Helpdesk team, supporting colleagues across multiple locations, including Amsterdam and Luxembourg. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service skills, an interest in IT, and the ability to communicate confidently in both German and English.

In this role, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues experiencing IT issues. Using an IVR system, you will receive inbound calls in either German or English and assist colleagues with a variety of IT-related queries and technical issues. You will also manage and update support tickets, ensuring issues are accurately logged and resolved in a timely manner.

Please note: You will be assessed on your German language proficiency during the recruitment process, as the role involves supporting German-speaking colleagues via telephone and written communication.

Day-to-Day Activities:
- Taking inbound calls from colleagues across Lloyds Banking Group.
- Logging, updating, and managing IT support tickets.
- Supporting users with password resets, system access queries, software issues, and basic troubleshooting.
- Providing regular updates to colleagues on the progress of their IT incidents.
- Escalating more complex technical issues to specialist support teams.
- Delivering a high standard of customer service in both German and English.

Key Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound IT support calls in German and English.
- Provide first-line support for IT faults and service desk queries.
- Manage and update tickets through the service management system.
- Work closely with offshore support teams who may log tickets on behalf of colleagues.
- Communicate clearly both verbally and in writing in German and English.
- Deliver excellent customer service while troubleshooting technical issues.

Must-Have Experience:
- Fluent spoken and written German and English.
- Excellent communication skills with confidence handling inbound telephone calls.
- Previous experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer service, contact centre, helpdesk, or service desk environments.
- Strong keyboard and administration skills with the ability to accurately update systems and tickets.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment whilst managing multiple queries.
- A genuine interest in IT and technology.

Ideal Experience:
- Previous IT Helpdesk, IT Service Desk, or Technical Support experience.
- Experience using ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Remedy, Zendesk, or similar.
- IT-related qualifications, studies, or training (college, university, apprenticeship, or certifications).
- Experience troubleshooting basic IT issues, including passwords, software, hardware, and system access queries.
- Experience supporting colleagues or customers in a bilingual environment.
- Understanding of ITIL or service management principles would be advantageous.

What Makes Someone a Strong Fit?
- Enjoys helping people and solving problems.
- Has a passion for technology and developing IT knowledge.
- Builds rapport easily over the telephone.
- Remains calm and professional when dealing with technical issues.
- Has strong attention to detail and can confidently communicate in both German and English, verbally and in writing.

Why Join Lloyds Banking Group?

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're committed to helping Britain prosper. You'll join a supportive and inclusive environment where you'll have opportunities to develop your career, build new skills, and make a real difference to our customers every day.

Benefits:
- Work from home 3 days per week
- Close to public transport links
- First class support and training for all colleagues
- Weekly Pay
- Online payslips
- Dedicated After Care Team
- Annual leave allowance of 31 days per year
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Access to Able Futures
- Eyecare vouchers
- Access to Boost benefits such as discounted shopping vouchers, services, attraction tickets and more
- Smart Spending App
- Workplace Pension scheme

title: Paralegal
description:
Paralegal

Join a supportive, forward-thinking property team handling varied conveyancing and leasing work. This full-time opportunity suits someone holding the required professional registration who enjoys client contact, managing a busy caseload and progressing their career.

If you've also worked in the following roles, we'd also like to hear from you: Conveyancing Paralegal, Property Paralegal, Residential Conveyancing Paralegal, Residential Property Paralegal, Real Estate Paralegal, Conveyancing Assistant, Property Legal Assistant, Legal Assistant

Benefits include a minimum of 33 days' holiday, the option to purchase additional leave, a generous pension scheme and structured development support.

SALARY: £33,000 - £40,000 per annum (depending on experience) + Benefits

LOCATION: Edinburgh, Scotland

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent

JOB OVERVIEW

Build your property law career in a supportive environment with varied client-facing work across conveyancing and leasing. The Paralegal will manage transactions and maintain strong client contact.

Working closely with colleagues and external parties, the Paralegal will help keep matters moving accurately and on time while contributing to a busy property team.

Structured training, ongoing professional development and supported progression give the Paralegal scope to grow while supporting clients and colleagues effectively.

As a successful candidate you will join a firm that has held Investors in People accreditation since 1997 and recently gained Gold accreditation. The firm are proud to be a friendly legal practice that genuinely cares about their staff. Many of their solicitors and support staff have been with them for over 30 years, reflecting the positive, inclusive culture they have worked hard to create

DUTIES

Your duties as the Paralegal include:
- Workload and Deadlines: Manage own workload to meet client deadlines
- Client Instructions: Deal promptly with client instructions
- Property and Leasing Transactions: Manage property and leasing transactions
- Estate Agency and ESPC Matters: Liaise with the estate agent and handle ESPC matters
- Client and Third-Party Liaison: Liaise with clients, estate agents and other third parties
- File Management: Proactively attend to file management
- Team Support: Provide support to other members of the property team

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL
- Professionally accredited or registered paralegal with a recognised legal professional body, with demonstrable knowledge and experience of Scots law relevant to the role
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to prioritise and manage a caseload effectively
- Strong business awareness of deadlines and working under pressure
- Excellent attention to detail

DESIRABLE
- Previous relevant experience
- Experience in a similar role dealing with purchase and sale transactions, title queries across Sasine and Land Registers, and notices of potential liability

BENEFITS
- Minimum of 33 days' holiday
- Option to purchase additional leave
- Generous pension scheme
- Structured training and ongoing professional development
- Supported progression and career growth
- Friendly, inclusive working environment

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details. CV's of Job Applicants meeting this requirement will be submitted to our Client for consideration. By submitting your job application to us you are hereby giving us your express consent to submit your details to our Client for this purpose.
